description:
Programme Overview

The HAB Research Fellowship 2028 at the Herzog August Bibliothek (Wolfenbüttel, Germany) is a research fellowship funded by the State of Lower Saxony. Two formats are available: Post-doc Fellowship (6-10 months, €2,200/month) and Short-term Fellowship (1-3 months, €1,800/month). Application deadline is 31 January 2027, with fellowships starting 1 January 2028.

Important Clarification

This is not a DAAD scholarship. It is listed in DAAD's database, but funding comes from the State of Lower Saxony and the programme is administered by the Herzog August Bibliothek.

Fellowship Types

Post-doc FellowshipShort-term Fellowship
Duration6-10 months1-3 months
Monthly stipend€2,200€1,800
Travel supportUp to €2,000 one-time reimbursement€150-€650 (varies by country)
Family supplement€300/month (1 child), €400 (2 children), €500 (3+)Not offered
EligibilityPhD within 6 years (PhD awarded 2021 or later for Jan 2027 applications)Post-docs to emeriti scholars, all career stages
Awards per year4-6 fellowships annuallyNumber not published

Eligibility Criteria

  • Post-doc Fellowship: Scholars within 6 years of PhD. For January 2027 applications, PhD must be awarded 2021 or later.
  • Short-term Fellowship: Open to all career stages from post-doc to emeriti scholars.
  • Nationality: No restriction. International scholars explicitly eligible.
  • Central requirement: Library holdings must be essential for proposed research project. Proposals must reference specific HAB manuscripts, collections, or source groups.
  • Eligible fields: Medieval and early-modern studies, manuscripts and rare books, cultural and intellectual history, literature, religion, art, law, and related humanities fields.

Application Process

  1. Email forschung@hab.de stating research focus and indicating "Post-doc" (6-10 months) or "Short-term" (1-3 months) in subject line. Application forms are provided via email.
  2. Complete and submit forms. External reviewers evaluate; final selection by Scientific Advisory Board.
  3. Guidelines and "Stipendien Wolfenbüttel 2028" PDF available in official download area.
  • Tip: Study HAB catalogue before writing. Reference relevant manuscripts and collections by name.

Required Documents

  • Application form (requested from HAB)
  • Research proposal referencing HAB holdings
  • PhD award date proof or academic status
  • CV
  • Recommendation letters

Application dates

DetailInformation
Application deadline31 January 2027
Fellowship start1 January 2028
HostHerzog August Bibliothek, Lessingplatz 1, D-38304 Wolfenbüttel, Germany

Contacts

  • Application email: forschung@hab.de
  • Deputy Head: Dr. Elizabeth Harding (+49 5331 808-208)
  • Gerlinde Strauß (+49 5331 808-205)

Official Links

  • English page: https://www.hab.de/en/forschungsstipendien/
  • German page: https://www.hab.de/forschungsstipendien

Important Notes

  • Not a DAAD scholarship. Funded by State of Lower Saxony, administered by HAB.
  • PhD students not eligible for short-term fellowship. Separate doctoral fellowship schemes exist.
  • Selection favours proposals referencing specific HAB manuscripts and demonstrating need for onsite research.
  • This is a funded research fellowship, not a full scholarship.
